proof_body:
by
  intro x n h
  have hd : 2 * Real.sin (x / 2) ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero h
  have e00 : (((0 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * x = x / 2 := by
    push_cast
    ring
  have e0 : ∀ m : ℕ, ((m : ℝ) + 1 + 1 / 2) * x = ((m : ℝ) + 1) * x + x / 2 := fun m => by ring
  have e1 : ∀ m : ℕ, ((m : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * x = ((m : ℝ) + 1) * x - x / 2 := fun m => by ring
  have hc : ∀ m : ℕ, 2 * Real.sin (x / 2) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, Real.cos (((k : ℝ) + 1) * x) = Real.sin (((m : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * x) - Real.sin (x / 2) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      rw [e00]
      simp
    | succ m ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, mul_add, ih]
      push_cast
      rw [e0, e1, Real.sin_add, Real.sin_sub]
      ring
  have hs : ∀ m : ℕ, 2 * Real.sin (x / 2) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, Real.sin (((k : ℝ) + 1) * x) = Real.cos (x / 2) - Real.cos (((m : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * x) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      rw [e00]
      simp
    | succ m ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, mul_add, ih]
      push_cast
      rw [e0, e1, Real.cos_add, Real.cos_sub]
      ring
  constructor
  · rw [eq_div_iff hd, mul_comm]
    exact hc n
  · rw [eq_div_iff hd, mul_comm]
    exact hs n
target_source: ∀ (x : ℝ) (n : ℕ), Real.sin (x / 2) ≠ 0 → ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, Real.cos (((k : ℝ) + 1) * x) = (Real.sin (((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * x) - Real.sin (x / 2)) / (2 * Real.sin (x / 2)) ∧ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, Real.sin (((k : ℝ) + 1) * x) = (Real.cos (x / 2) - Real.cos (((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * x)) / (2 * Real.sin (x / 2))
